art_direction: 细长眼半垂但保持开口，双瞳共同向左，短眉平稳，嘴线极短。
composition: centered pair of coordinated eyes with restrained brows and short mouth; ample pale negative space

color_randomization.method: seeded golden-angle hue spacing with random harmony, saturation, lightness, and shuffled color modes

creative_direction: Draw two long, slender comic eyes with a gently lowered upper lid and a nearly level central axis. Keep enough height to show the substantial pupils and their broad highlights clearly. Both pupils travel together to the left, suggesting consideration rather than suspicion. The lower contours are fine, slightly bowed lines with tiny natural interruptions; the upper contours are only a little heavier. Restrict white areas to slim corner spaces and keep the iris fields compact. Two steady short brows remain relaxed, and an especially brief horizontal mouth adds restraint. Let the outer corners taper gradually instead of becoming long eyeliner wings. Balance the pair centrally with generous negative space and no extra creases.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: inspected: centered two-eye composition and archive integrity; retained as an unsuccessful style experiment after user feedback that the clean contours, recurring round pupils and regular highlights look too AI-generated; do not count as an accepted final image
batch_status: stopped after user style feedback; no further generation in this direction
